fixCommits.msg: fix(learning): ultra-audit — self-healing hooks, honest heartbeat/dashboard, trimmer pattern coverage
fixCommits.body:
Root cause found: the entire post-commit learning loop was DORMANT
(core.hooksPath unset in fresh clones) while heartbeat pings masked the
silence and system-health reported 88/B. Four fixes:

1. heartbeat.cjs self-heals dormant hooks at session start + every
   commit; package.json 'prepare' wires hooks on npm install; dormancy
   emits a warning event so recurrence is learnable
2. heartbeat + learning-loop system-idle now IGNORE heartbeat pings —
   only real events attest that a system ran
3. system-health: new 'hooks' collector (dormant = 0/failing, weight
   1.5), observer score decays with age, stale gates cost points
   instead of vanishing
4. memory-trimmer now trims memory.patterns keyed maps + arrays
   (161KB → 140KB) and rotates the archive dir

Plus: AUDIT-recursive-learning-2026-07-05.md (full findings), removed
40MB biome core dump.

fixCommits.body:
ULTRA-ANALYSIS findings (evidence-based, measured — not guesswork):
- ~18 .cjs tools hardcoded ANSI color escapes (const B='\x1b[1m'...) that were
  NOT TTY-aware. Measured leak when piped: quality-scorecard 48, deploy-gate 13,
  agent-loop 9, factory-memory 3, intent-parser 1, art-pipeline 1 — 74+ raw
  escape sequences corrupting piped output, CI logs, and (worst) --json output.
  This is a real correctness bug, not just duplication.
- 3 tools copy-pasted an identical --name=value flag() parser.
- ROOT path resolution duplicated across 15 files.

Deliberately NOT refactored (would be reckless churn, no functional gain):
- the 1500-line mycelium-miner.cjs / mined-data tooling (working, generated)
- src/routes/*.ts (large but cohesive, no duplication signal)
'Big' is not the same as 'needs refactor.'

THE FIX — one home for the plumbing (tools/lib/aitell-common.cjs):
- colors(): now respects NO_COLOR / FORCE_COLOR and only emits codes to a real
  TTY, so piped/captured output is clean.

fixCommits.msg: fix(learning): repair the silent heal loop — eval bridge, blame guard, recency-aware health
fixCommits.body:
Root causes fixed (each one was rotting a learning system silently):

1. sentinel-eval freshness rule was a no-op heal: it ran 'sentinel.cjs --quick'
   which writes sentinel-report.json, never .mycelium/eval.json. eval.json sat
   119 days stale and 'stale: sentinel-eval' appeared on every health run.
   -> new tools/sentinel-eval-bridge.cjs projects the sentinel summary into
   eval.json (reuses a <1h report when present); freshness rule rewired to it.

2. blame-linker sprayed 'fatal: bad revision' into last-error.log on every
   post-commit run: squash-merges rewrite history so mined hashes (b855259,
   dc5ae0d, ...) stop resolving. -> guard with git rev-parse --verify before
   any blame/diff; stderr suppressed in run(). 182/192 fixes now link clean.

3. Health scores never recovered after fixes: every last-error.log block ever
   logged subtracted 10 points forever, and a Feb-18 smoke report counted as a
   live failing gate in June. -> collectErrors() scores only 14d-recent block

Bug (visible on iPhone, narrow viewports):
  On <=520px the merch-grid switches to a single-column list with each card laid
  out as 2 columns: 120px photo + 1fr body. The desktop base rule
  '.merch-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column}' was still affecting the
  photo's height calculation, and '.ph{aspect-ratio:3/4}' from the desktop rule
  cascaded in, making the photo column ~160px tall and pushing the title
  ('The Thesis Journal', 'The Espresso Cup', etc.) BEHIND the image.

Fix (in the @media (max-width:520px) block):
  - Make .merch-card a real CSS grid with explicit row/column placement.
  - Pin .ph: grid-column 1 / row 1, aspect-ratio 1/1, width 120px, min-height 120px,
    flex:none (kills any inherited flex sizing).
  - Pin .body: grid-column 2 / row 1, padding 12/14, min-width:0, overflow:hidden.
  - Add overflow-wrap:anywhere + word-break:break-word on body text so long
    English titles don't push the column wider than its track.

Result: photo strictly in col 1, bod

fixCommits.msg: fix(cinematic): iOS Safari rewatch — overlay invisible, page content bleeds through
fixCommits.body:
Root cause: On iOS Safari, position:fixed + pointer-events:none causes the
WebKit compositor to deprioritize the overlay, allowing page content (hero
section) to paint ABOVE the cinematic wrapper despite z-index:99999.

User's screen recording showed: tap REWATCH → black overlay appears briefly →
page content (stats, buttons) renders on top of video → appears 'nothing happened'.

Architecture v4 fix:
- Remove pointer-events:none from CSS; toggle via JS (auto when active, none when dismissed)
- Add -webkit-transform:translateZ(0) to force GPU compositing layer
- Eliminate separate #nwg-cine-touch overlay — wrapper itself handles taps
- activateWrap()/deactivateWrap() functions manage visibility + pointer-events
- handleWrapTap() replaces tapToPlay() — handles unmute and play from wrapper
- videoStartedMuted flag preserves 'TAP TO UNMUTE' after confirmPlaying()
- Forced reflow (wrap.offsetHeight) before opacity change for iOS Safari
- togglePause() respects muted state in status display

fixCommits.msg: fix(cinematic): rewrite player for bulletproof mobile touch
fixCommits.body:
ROOT CAUSE: Skip button was unresponsive on mobile because:
1. #nwg-cinematic (position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999) had pointer-events:auto
   set via JS, making it capture ALL touch events across the entire viewport
2. Mobile browsers dispatch touchstart to the first element in hit-test order
   that accepts pointer-events — the wrapper grabbed touches before buttons
3. The wrapper's tapToPlayTouch handler called e.preventDefault(), eating events
4. Even with buttons at z-index:100001, they shared a stacking context issue

FIX — Three-layer architecture:
- Layer 1: #nwg-cinematic (z:99999) — visual only, pointer-events:none on
  itself AND all children. Never captures any touch/click events.
- Layer 2: #nwg-cine-touch (z:100000) — invisible tap overlay for
  play/unmute. Self-removes (display:none) after first tap so it can never
  block button presses afterwards.
- Layer 3: Skip/Pause buttons (z:200001) — completely outside all wrapper
  divs, independent stacking context, guarantee

4. gitwise Action 7: deep root-cause analysis — extracts recurring themes from

7. Two new learnings recorded for automation area

PIPELINE NOW: commit → hook → learn → snapshot → selfHeal(3) → eval → sync
